title: Settings
subtitle: Configure every aspect of your agent workspace

tabs.displayDesc: Workbench chrome, status chip, refine timers, and tool/memory injection toggles — mirrors the TUI SettingsPicker.
tabs.generalDesc: Appearance, language, and display preferences — mirrors the TUI SettingsPicker.
tabs.providerDesc: API keys, saved providers, and the provider catalog.
tabs.connectionDesc: WebSocket server URL and connection health.
tabs.agentDesc: Autonomy, prompt refinement, reasoning, and model routing.
tabs.executionDesc: Iteration caps, exit behavior, and process circuit breaker.
tabs.fallbacksDesc: Model fallback chain, favorites, and named fallback profiles.
tabs.routingDesc: Per-phase and per-role model route matrix.
tabs.fleetDesc: Subagent concurrency, streaming, and next-step prediction.
tabs.integrationsDesc: HQ client, MCP servers, and Telegram notifications.
tabs.contextDesc: Feature flags, context strategy, compactor, and plugin controls.
tabs.logsDesc: Log level, audit detail, filesystem access scope, and debug stream.
tabs.securityDesc: Brain decision control, shadow agent, and tool access.

general.themeSystemHint: System follows your OS-level light/dark preference.
general.soundOnCompleteHint: Play a soft chime when a run finishes.
general.titleAnimationHint: Show animated terminal title in the CLI.
general.showThinkingHint: Display completed reasoning blocks in the chat history.
general.groupToolCallsHint: Collapse consecutive tool calls into a single chip.
general.autoCollapseInputHint: When a session with messages loads, collapse the composer under the history. Off by default — input stays expanded until you collapse it manually.
general.languageHint: Changes only the interface text. Prompts, skills, and model output are not affected.
general.animationStyleHint: Animation for the TUI working-state chip.
general.thinkingWordHint: Word shown in the TUI status chip. Single short word.
general.paletteHint: Pick the main color (and its derivatives). Neutral surfaces stay the same.

model.heading: Model
model.notFound: No models found for this provider. The catalog might be empty or still loading.

providerHealth.heading: Provider Health
providerHealth.hint: Which provider/model pairs are healthy, degraded, or blocked — and why.
providerHealth.explain402: Billing limit reached (402). Blocked for ~15 minutes until quota resets.
providerHealth.explain403quota: Usage limit reached for this billing cycle. Blocked until the next cycle resets (~15 min).
providerHealth.explain403auth: Permission/auth error. Non-retryable — check your API key and access rights.
providerHealth.explain429: Rate limit hit (429). Temporary throttle — recovers automatically.
providerHealth.explain529: Server overloaded (529). The provider is under heavy load.
providerHealth.explainNetwork: Network unreachable. Check your internet or the provider's status page.
providerHealth.explainTimeout: Request timed out (408). The provider was slow to respond.
providerHealth.explainStreamHang: Stream stalled (599). The provider stopped mid-response.
providerHealth.explainQuota: Quota exhausted. Blocked until the reset window.

connection.wsUrlHint: URL of the agent WebSocket server. The server runs alongside the CLI.
connection.startingBody: For development, run ./dev.ps1 from the repo root (optionally set WS_HOST/WS_PORT first). Otherwise launch the WebUI with the CLI: wstack --webui.
connection.healthHint: Live ownership, storage, queue, watcher, and latency report for project services.
connection.healthRestartRequired: Restart the backend once to activate connection health reporting.
connection.endpointInvalidRemedy: The IPC socket path exceeds this platform's length limit, so the shared daemon cannot start. Queries fall back to a slower process-local mode. Remedy: set a shorter TMPDIR (e.g. export TMPDIR=/tmp) and restart WrongStack.

provider.apiKeysBody: Pick a provider from the catalog and add an API key, or manage saved providers.
provider.orEnv: Or set {{env}} in the environment instead.
provider.manageKeys: Manage your API keys and provider configurations
provider.noSavedHint: Add a provider to get started

providerModels.emptyState: No models yet — add from the catalog or create a custom model.

mcp.fieldDescriptionPlaceholder: GitHub MCP server for repository access
mcp.lazyConnectHint: (don't start until first tool call; auto-sleeps when idle)
mcp.heading: MCP Servers
mcp.recommendedBody: One-click add for popular MCP servers. Click Add to pre-fill the configuration, then confirm. Servers requiring credentials will need their env vars set before use.
mcp.noServersHint: Switch to the Recommended tab to add popular servers, or Add Custom for your own.
mcp.addCustomBody: Configure a custom MCP server with stdio, SSE, or HTTP transport.
mcp.addCustomBodyHint: For popular servers, use the Recommended tab instead — everything is pre-configured for you.
mcp.removeConfirmBody: This removes the MCP server from your configuration.

allowlist.title: Clear saved allowlist?
allowlist.body_one: This will remove the pinned model for {{provider}}. The model picker will fall back to the models.dev catalog.
allowlist.body_other: This will remove the {{count}} pinned models for {{provider}}. The model picker will fall back to the models.dev catalog.
allowlist.undoHint: You can undo this for 8 seconds after confirming.

oauth.termsWarning: Sign in with a subscription instead of an API key. Using a subscription outside its official client may violate the provider's Terms — your account could be rate-limited or banned. An API key is the sanctioned path for programmatic use.
oauth.waitingBrowser: Waiting for you to sign in…
oauth.pasteLoopbackBusy: Loopback port busy — paste the redirect URL
oauth.pasteCantReach: Browser can't reach this server? Paste the redirect URL
oauth.enterCode: Enter this code at the verification page:

agent.autonomyModeHint: How independently the agent proceeds between turns.
agent.autoProceedDelayHint: Milliseconds before the agent auto-proceeds in Auto mode. 0 = immediate.
agent.yoloHint: Bypass tool confirmation prompts — the agent runs without asking.
agent.enableRefineHint: Rewrite prompts before sending — clearer instructions, better results.
agent.refineDelayHint: Countdown before the refined prompt auto-sends.
agent.refineLanguageHint: Keep your language or translate to English for the model.
agent.refinerProviderHint: Provider for goal refinement. Select one from your configured providers.
agent.refinerModelHint: Model for goal refinement. Requires a refiner provider first.
agent.refinerProfileHint: Named fallback profile for goal refinement. Overrides provider+model.
agent.refinerProfileDefault: None — use provider+model or session defaults
agent.reasoningModeHint: Control how the model uses extended thinking. Auto = provider default.
agent.reasoningEffortHint: How much compute the model spends thinking. Only sent when the model supports it.
agent.preserveThinkingHint: Keep reasoning blocks across turns for context continuity.
agent.cacheTtlHint: Prompt cache time-to-live. 1h costs more on write but saves on repeat reads (Anthropic).
agent.capsHint: Use wstack models caps to check what the current model supports. Unsupported settings are silently omitted per-request.
agent.autonomyDelayMsHint: Milliseconds before the agent auto-proceeds in Auto mode. 0 = immediate.
agent.refineCountdownHint: Grace period before the refined prompt auto-sends (milliseconds).
agent.reasoningEffortModelSet: levels offered by the active model
agent.reasoningEffortUnsupported: Not offered by this model (supported: {{levels}}) — the setting will be omitted.

execution.heading: Execution
execution.maxIterationsHint: Hard cap on LLM turns per agent.run().
execution.autoProceedMaxIterationsHint: Stop auto-proceed after N iterations. 0 = unlimited.
execution.confirmExitHint: First Ctrl+C aborts work, second confirms exit.
execution.chimeHint: Terminal bell when an agent run finishes.
execution.breakerHint: Gate bash/exec after repeated failures; trips arm the kill/reset countdown.
execution.breakerTimeoutHint: Delay before automatic kill/reset when the breaker trips. 0 = manual recovery.
execution.availabilityHint: Prevent autonomous and overnight runs from using selected providers or models during recurring windows.

features.chimeraDedicatedHint: Automated code quality review that runs after every agent session. Catches regressions, anti-patterns, and potential bugs.
features.chimeraSectionEnabledHint: Run a code review agent after every iteration.
features.chimeraProviderHint: Provider for the review agent. Select one from your configured providers.
features.chimeraModelHint: Model for the review agent. Requires a provider first.
features.chimeraMaxFilesHint: Maximum number of changed files included in a single review call.
features.chimeraAutoFixHint: Whether the review agent should automatically apply fixes for issues it finds.
features.autoReviewCascadeOnHint: When a review finds issues at or above this severity, spawn follow-up agents.
features.chimeraPickModelHint: Select a provider and model for post-session code review.
features.autoReviewSectionEnabledHint: Run a review agent mid-session on every file change.
features.autoReviewFallbackProfileHint: Named model profile for auto-review. It supplies the fallback pool and the models used by round-robin or random selection.
features.autoReviewFallbackProfileNone: None — use provider+model or session defaults
features.autoReviewModelSelectionHint: Choose the next profile model in order, or pick a random starting model for each review.
features.autoReviewFallbackModelsHint: Models resolved from the selected profile or global chain; they form both the selection pool and the retry chain.
features.autoReviewModelHint: Model for the auto-review agent. Requires a provider first.
features.autoReviewDebounceHint: Minimum gap between review triggers after a file change.
features.autoReviewCascadeHint: Follow-up agent threshold — spawns security-scanner and bug-hunter above this severity.
features.autoReviewPickModelHint: Select a provider and model, or a named fallback profile, for mid-session auto-review.
features.pluginsPerPluginHint: Enable or disable individual plugins. Changes take effect on next session.

fallbacks.heading: Fallback / Round-robin Models
fallbacks.body: These ordered model chains support failover and profile-based round-robin selection. On rate limits, 5xx errors, or stalls, the agent retries on the next available model.
fallbacks.autoFallbackHint: When the chain above is empty, auto-derive one from your keyed providers.
fallbacks.favoritesOnlyHint: When auto fallback derives a chain, restrict it to your favorite models.
fallbacks.favoritesEmpty: Favorites are shown first and can constrain auto fallback.

fleet.heading: Fleet & Streaming
fleet.fleetChatVerbosityHint: Show live subagent activity in the fleet panel.
fleet.maxConcurrentHint: Maximum number of subagents that can run simultaneously.
fleet.nextPredictionHint: After a turn completes, predict likely next steps.
fleet.nextStepsToolHint: Let the agent record its follow-up suggestions with a tool call instead of writing the block by hand. Applies to the next session.

integrations.heading: Integrations
integrations.hqPublishingHint: Publish this WebUI/client session to WrongStack HQ.
integrations.hqRawContentHint: Send raw content previews to HQ instead of redacted previews.
integrations.wrongProxyEnabledLabel: Route base URLs through the local proxy
integrations.wrongProxyEnabledHint: When enabled, every provider's base URL is rewritten through the configured proxy (default http://localhost:3444/proxy/<host><path>). openai-codex is excluded — it talks directly to the ChatGPT backend with an OAuth-issued token.
integrations.wrongProxyUrlHint: Where the local proxy daemon listens. The system periodically probes <url>/api/health; an unreachable daemon disables rewriting without retrying every keystroke.
integrations.wrongProxyChangesApply: Changes apply immediately to subsequent requests — no restart needed.
integrations.telegramSessionEndHint: Send a summary when a session ends.
integrations.telegramDelegateHint: Send a humanized note when a subagent completes.
integrations.telegramLongToolHint: Notify when a tool exceeds {{ms}}ms. Set 0 to disable.
integrations.disabledHint: Enable the feature in the Context tab to use this section.

context.heading: Context & Memory
context.memoryHint: Persist and recall facts across sessions.
context.indexOnStartHint: Build the codebase symbol index at session start.
context.modelsRegistryHint: Use the models.dev catalog for provider discovery.
context.autoCompactHint: Automatically trim the context window when near limits.
context.compactorStrategyHint: How the context is compacted when it grows too large.
context.contextModeHint: Context window policy — balanced is the default.
context.contextModeDeep: Deep — larger context for complex tasks
context.tokenSavingHint: Controls the next session's direct tool schemas and system prompt size.
context.tokenSavingAuto: Auto — adapt prompt to the model window
context.tokenSavingAggressive: Aggressive — smallest direct surface and prompt
context.pluginsPerPluginHint: Enable or disable individual plugins. Changes take effect on next session.

logs.heading: Logs & Debug
logs.auditLevelHint: Detail level for session audit logs.
logs.fsAccessHint: Scope of the file tools. Applies on the next session.
logs.debugStreamHint: Raw SSE hex-dump to the server stderr for provider debugging.

security.heading: Security & Monitoring
security.brainHint: Decision models, council, escalation and risk ceiling — applied live, saved to the global config.
security.shadowHint: The Shadow Agent monitors all fleet agents, tracks their tasks, and detects anomalies.
security.toolsHint: Enable or disable individual tools. Mutating tools are marked in amber.
security.breakerHint: Gate bash/exec after repeated failures; trips arm the kill/reset countdown.

toast.modelSwitchedNextRequest: Model switched: {{from}} → {{to}}. Active for the next LLM request.
toast.modelSwitchedRunActive: Model switched: {{from}} → {{to}}. Active for the next LLM request; the current run continues and is not restarted.
toast.selectProviderModelFirst: Select a provider and model first
toast.modelSwitchTimeout: Model switch timed out. Please try again.

display.workbenchHint: Toggle visibility of workbench surfaces in the chat view.
display.showModelReasoningHint: Render LLM reasoning/thinking blocks in chat history (TUI parity).
display.showAgentSwarmPanelHint: Controls where the agent swarm (fleet + mission queue) is displayed.
display.titleAnimationHint: Animate the terminal/tab title with run-state status (TUI parity).
display.keyboardShortcutsHint: Enable global keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+K, Alt+1..4, Vim keys, etc.). Off by default.
display.statusChipHint: Visual style for the TUI/CLI statusline and working-state chip.
display.thinkingWordHint: Single short word shown in the TUI status chip while the agent is working.
display.statuslineModeHint: Density of the TUI statusline rail.
display.animationStyleHint: Animation for the TUI working-state chip.
display.refineHint: Configure the pre-refine grace countdown and the multi-diff summary footer cutoff.
display.preRefineSecondsHint: Grace period before the refiner starts (seconds). 0 = skip the countdown and refine immediately.
display.multiDiffSummaryHint: Minimum number of files before the aggregate 'N files · +X -Y' footer is shown above per-file blocks.
display.memoryHint: Toggle what the read tool includes and when SAGE memory blocks are surfaced in tool results.
display.readSymbolsHint: When true, the read tool includes codebase-index symbols alongside file content.
display.showSageMemoryInjectHint: When true, surface SAGE memory-injection blocks in tool results.
display.sageMemoryInjectThresholdHint: Minimum relation strength required for an injected SAGE memory (0.72–0.95).
display.footnote: Settings here mirror the TUI /settings picker. Toggles apply live; some fields require a session restart.

resetConfirmBody: This restores default settings and reloads the page.

brain.heading: Brain
brain.headingHint: Decision models, council, escalation and risk ceiling — applied live, saved to the global config.
brain.escalationModeHint: Headless: the Brain never blocks on a human — unanswered escalations resolve via the safe terminal policy. Applies to CLI/TUI sessions; the standalone WebUI Brain is always headless.
brain.escalationDecisionTimeoutHint: Per-LLM-call time budget for one Brain decision.
brain.escalationHumanTimeoutHint: Interactive mode: how long an escalation prompt may wait before the terminal policy resolves it.
brain.escalationTerminalPolicyHint: How a headless escalation resolves with no human available. Conservative accepts a recommended option at low/medium risk; deny-all never auto-accepts; continue-on-recommended accepts a recommended option at ANY risk.
brain.escalationDecisionLogSizeHint: Rolling in-memory decision log kept for the status view.
brain.rulesBody: Evaluated before any provider call — first match wins. Edit them in the global config file; this view is read-only.
brain.heuristicsBody: Free pattern guesses that settle a question before any model runs. All on by default — turn one off when its guess is wrong for your workload.
brain.heuristicsLowRiskHint: Auto-answer low-risk requests that already carry a recommended option.
brain.heuristicsBlockedHint: 'blocked …' plus an explicit resolution marker in the context resolves to continue.
brain.heuristicsDeadlockHint: 'deadlock' plus failed work units in the context resolves to skip and continue.
brain.heuristicsRetryHint: 'failed'/'retry' plus demonstrably exhausted retries marks the unit failed and moves on.
brain.heuristicsPingHint: A bare continue/proceed ping with no competing alternative resolves to continue.
brain.qualityResponseBudgetHint: Output tokens per decision call. A Brain response is one decision plus a one-sentence rationale.
brain.qualityRejectHint: Treat a declined or empty response as 'this tier could not decide' instead of accepting it as an answer.
brain.qualityMinConfidenceHint: Reject answers whose self-reported confidence is below this. Responses reporting no confidence always pass.
brain.qualityDenyTerminalHint: Whether a deny from the single-LLM tier ends the decision. 'when-decided' makes a genuine refusal terminal while infrastructure failures still escalate.
brain.traceRecordHint: Per-decision JSONL of every tier, pool target and council vote, with timings and token usage. Off by default — enabling it writes decision content to disk.
brain.traceContentHint: 'full' keeps question and context (needed to replay a decision); 'redacted' truncates free text; 'none' records metadata only.
brain.cacheReplayHint: Reuse a previous council/LLM verdict for an identical repeated question. Deterministic tiers and ask-human are never cached; a decision the ledger observes to have failed is evicted.
brain.cacheLifetimeHint: How long a cached verdict stays replayable.
brain.monitorBody: Distress-signal self-activation. The monitor is built once at boot, so these apply to the next session rather than live.
brain.monitorWatchHint: Tool-failure streaks, error storms, agent stalls and file churn engage the Brain on their own.
brain.monitorPolicyHint: How a detected signal resolves. 'llm' consults the Brain; 'steer' always intervenes and 'observe' never does — both without a provider call.
brain.modelsUseSessionHint: Decide with whatever model the session is running. Turn off by adding models below.
brain.modelsPoolStrategyHint: Fallback: first model is primary, the rest are tried in order on failure. Round-robin: decisions rotate across the pool.
brain.councilEnableHint: High-stakes questions are voted on by independent seats (executor / skeptic-with-veto / auditor) instead of one model. Needs ≥2 resolvable voters (explicit seats below, or a ≥2-model pool).
brain.councilCustomLens: Custom decision lens — sent to the seat verbatim.
brain.councilRiskFloorHint: Minimum question risk that convenes the council instead of the single-model tier.
brain.councilJudgeDesc: Tie-breaker model that sees every vote's rationale.
brain.councilQuorumHint: Fraction of seats that must return a valid vote.
brain.councilApprovalHint: Fraction of cast vote weight the winning option must exceed.
brain.councilPerSeatTimeoutHint: Time budget for a single seat's vote. Slower than the decision timeout means one stalled seat holds up the vote.
brain.councilMaxConcurrencyHint: How many seats vote in parallel. Lower this when the pool shares one rate-limited provider.
brain.councilDistinctnessHint: Reject duplicate seats: 'model' requires distinct models, 'provider' requires independent providers so one outage cannot sway the vote.
brain.councilVoterBudgetHint: Output tokens per seat call — reasoning models spend thinking tokens from this budget.
brain.councilJudgeBudgetHint: Output tokens for the tie-breaking judge call.
brain.ledgerRecordHint: Persists every decision and its observed outcome; similar past outcomes are fed back into future Brain prompts.
brain.ledgerAutoDenyHint: Deny deterministically (no LLM) once this many consecutive approvals of a decision group ended in observed failures.
brain.ledgerMemoryEntriesHint: Ring size held in memory, and the number of past entries seeded from disk at boot.
brain.ledgerRetryWindowHint: A same-kind monitor intervention re-firing inside this window marks the previous steer as a failure.
brain.recentEmpty: No decisions recorded yet this session.
brain.pickPoolHint: Ordered decision pool — first is primary.
brain.pickVoterHint: Dialog stays open — add ≥2 voters, then close.
brain.persistError: Settings applied live but not saved.
